relationships.subject: METTL14

relationships.subject: LRIG1

relationships.subject: METTL14
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL14 knockdown alleviates TNF-α-induced cellular senescence in NP cells

key_findings: METTL14 is upregulated in severely degenerated NP tissue and by TNF-alpha, and stabilizes LRIG1 mRNA via m6A.
LRIG1 overexpression rescues ECM loss and senescence caused by METTL14 knockdown.
